attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the roofs, chimney, alley and back (CC BY 4.0): the Spuistraat front's cream ground floor with the BITTERZOET canopy and logo plaque, red brick storeys banded with cream speklagen, windows under chequered relieving arches, corner pilasters, cornice and attic, and the north-east side's brick storeys, doorcase and dormers. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
